spec: Per COMBAT_AND_CLASS_OVERHAUL_PLAN.md §6.1 — 3 paths × ~27 nodes; 51 points total; tier-N gates at (N-1)*5 points; tier-7 capstone gates at ~31 points; multi-rank passives ~70%; identity/keystone ~30%.
designNotes: Class-First Principle (LOCKED §4.2): class trees are weapon-agnostic. NO weapon-conditional nodes. Offhand-conditional nodes (second_weapon offhand for Blademaster dual-wield) ARE allowed per §6.3.

Idle-game context: no movement/standing mechanics; combat is per-zone encounter; no tile concept (use 'all enemies in encounter' / 'in zone'). Shadow Caltrops trap is a zone-effect, not a movement-locked AoE.
Multi-rank flavor directive: 14 of 81 nodes (~17%) are pure stat-sticks; the remaining 67 carry proc/conditional/identity/cross-weapon flavor. Passive scaling is the EXCEPTION.

Buff migrations from SKILL_FANTASY_AUDIT absorbed: Predator's Mark (Blademaster T4) ← cut button, halved values, conditioned on offhand second-weapon equip; Venom Covenant (Venomcraft T2) ← cut button, conditioned on poison-active state; Shadow Covenant (Shadowdancer T4) ← cut button, conditioned on Shadow Mark active.
Cross-weapon node: Cross-Weapon Cascade (Shadowdancer T4) — Crit Cascade triggers regardless of weapon equipped (per §8.2 cross-weapon combo-state propagation).

All 3 capstones reshape Crit Cascade signature: Bladestorm (Blademaster) compounds Cascade tempo via cooldown refunds; Toxic Saint (Venomcraft) makes poisons crit + immune-to-decay while Shadow Mark active; Untouchable (Shadowdancer) makes Shadow Mark application universal + Marked hits generate Shadow Momentum.
Base-mechanic dependencies tracked per-node in `dependencies` array. Phase C engineering can grep for these to know which mechanics block which nodes.

paths.name: Blademaster
paths.theme: Dual-wield crit-burst. Faster swings, fan-strikes, cooldown refund chains. The endless rotation; crits beget crits beget cooldowns.

nodes.name: Honed Edge
nodes.description: +1/2/3/4/5% crit chance.

nodes.name: Quick Hands
nodes.description: Stab has +5/10/15/20/25% chance to fire twice on cast.

nodes.name: Killing Tempo
nodes.description: Multi-hit skills (Blade Dance, Fan of Knives) have +2/4/6/8/10% chance to deal +50% damage on each hit.

nodes.name: Pinpoint
nodes.description: On crit, +5/10/15/20/25% chance for the next Shadow Mark application to skip its cooldown.

nodes.name: Bladework
nodes.description: +2/4/6/8/10% attack speed (foundation pacing — pairs with Cascade tempo).

nodes.name: Cutting Edge
nodes.description: +5/10/15/20/25% crit damage (foundation scaling).

nodes.name: Twin Strike
nodes.description: While second-weapon offhand is equipped, +5/10/15/20/25% attack speed on offhand-tagged skills (offhand-conditional per §6.3).

nodes.name: Cascading Crit
nodes.description: Crits have +1/2/3% chance to add an extra Crit Stack (signature accelerator).

nodes.name: Bleeding Edge
nodes.description: Bleed ticks have +2/4/6/8/10% chance to crit (integrates §8.3 phys→bleed baseline with Cascade).

nodes.name: Flurry
nodes.description: Blade Dance has +20/40/60% chance to fire 1 extra hit.

nodes.name: Eviscerate
nodes.description: Crits have +5/10/15/20/25% chance to immediately refresh Stab cooldown.

nodes.name: Cascade Reservoir
nodes.description: Maximum Crit Stacks +1/2/3 (raises §3.2 Cascade ceiling).

nodes.name: Predator's Mark
nodes.description: While second-weapon offhand is equipped, +10% crit chance and +20% crit mult. (Migrated from Predator's Mark active buff per SKILL_FANTASY_AUDIT — cut button, halved values, conditioned on dual-wield offhand per §6.3.)

nodes.name: Killing Edge
nodes.description: Crit hits have +1/2/3/4/5% chance to deal triple damage instead of normal crit damage (replaces flat crit-mult scaling with a spike-proc).

nodes.name: Bladestorm Tempo
nodes.description: Each Crit Stack you have reduces all skill cooldowns by -0.1/-0.2/-0.3s (max -0.5/-1.0/-1.5s with 5 stacks).

nodes.name: Counter Edge
nodes.description: On taking a hit, +5/10/15/20/25% chance to gain a guaranteed-crit charge (consumed on next attack).

nodes.name: Crit Mastery
nodes.description: +2/4/6/8/10% crit chance (foundation pairing with Cascade gates).

nodes.name: Doubled Stroke
nodes.description: Hits on Shadow Marked targets have +1/2/3/4/5% chance to fire twice.

nodes.name: Sharpshot
nodes.description: On crit, +1/2/3 mana refunded to the consumed skill's mana cost.

nodes.name: Bladework Mastery
nodes.description: Skill cast intervals reduced by +1/2/3/4/5% per Crit Stack on any active Shadow Marked target.

nodes.name: Phantom Edge
nodes.description: +5/10/15/20/25% crit damage against Shadow Marked targets.

nodes.name: Cascade Wave
nodes.description: On reaching 5 Crit Stacks, your next crit fires a chaos AoE around the target dealing 100% spell power as splash to all enemies in encounter.

nodes.name: Steel Wind
nodes.description: Multi-target skills gain +1 enemy hit (Fan of Knives, Blade Dance, Chain Strike).

nodes.name: Twin Reaping
nodes.description: While second-weapon offhand is equipped, kills refund 1/2/3% of maximum mana per kill.

nodes.name: Refraction
nodes.description: Crits have +5/10/15% chance to apply Exposed regardless of skill (cross-state proc — works on any class skill).

nodes.name: Bladestorm
nodes.description: Crits have 30% chance to refund the consumed skill's cooldown. While second-weapon offhand is equipped, chain-hit skills (Blade Dance, Fan of Knives, Chain Strike) gain +1 hit. (Mirrors §10.1 Blademaster ascendancy keystone — reshapes Crit Cascade tempo via cooldown refunds.)

nodes.name: Storm Cascade
nodes.description: At 5 Crit Stacks, all your skills can crit twice (independent crit rolls per hit).

paths.name: Venomcraft
paths.theme: Poison snapshot specialist. Stack poisons deeper, make them crit, fuse poison with Crit Cascade. The Apothecary; poison ticks ARE Cascade triggers.

nodes.name: Tainted Blade
nodes.description: Poison ticks have +2/4/6/8/10% chance to apply an extra Poison stack.

nodes.name: Toxic Edge
nodes.description: +5/10/15/20/25% poison damage (foundation scaling).

nodes.name: Lingering Doom
nodes.description: +0.5/1.0/1.5/2.0/2.5s poison duration.

nodes.name: Vile Reservoir
nodes.description: Maximum poison stacks +1/2/3.

nodes.name: Snake's Coil
nodes.description: Viper Strike has +20/40/60/80/100% chance to apply Deep Wound twice on cast.

nodes.name: Plague Bearer
nodes.description: Poison ticks have +1/2/3/4/5% chance to also apply 1 stack of poison to a different enemy in encounter (poison spread).

nodes.name: Venom Covenant
nodes.description: While you have an active poison stack on any target, +25% attack speed and +10% damage. (Migrated from Venom Covenant active buff per SKILL_FANTASY_AUDIT — cut button, conditioned on poison-active state to make Venomcraft loop-driven, not button-driven.)

nodes.name: Toxic Burst
nodes.description: Poison ticks against Shadow Marked targets have +5/10/15/20/25% chance to deal +100% damage.

nodes.name: Withering Strike
nodes.description: Hits against poisoned enemies have +2/4/6/8/10% chance to add a Crit Stack regardless of crit (signature-Cascade feeder via DoT state).

nodes.name: Snake Pit
nodes.description: Fan of Knives has +20/40/60% chance to apply 2 poison stacks per hit.

nodes.name: Acrid Concentration
nodes.description: Each active poison stack on a target grants +1/2/3% damage on hits to that target.

nodes.name: Toxin Reservoir
nodes.description: Maximum poison stacks +2/4/6/8/10 (stacks with Vile Reservoir).

nodes.name: Necrotic Bite
nodes.description: Critical hits apply 1/2/3 stacks of poison automatically (Cascade-poison fusion: crits feed your poison engine).

nodes.name: Slow Decay
nodes.description: Poison ticks deal +5/10/15/20/25% damage to enemies below 50% HP.

nodes.name: Toxic Pandemic
nodes.description: When a poisoned enemy dies, +25/50/75% chance their remaining poison stacks transfer to the nearest enemy at full duration. (Asn micro-Pandemic — distinct from WD's full Pandemic.)

nodes.name: Sharpened Toxin
nodes.description: Poison ticks have +1/2/3/4/5% chance to crit (preview of Toxic Saint capstone effect).

nodes.name: Snake's Eye
nodes.description: On poison-tick crit, +25/50/75% chance to add a Crit Stack (full DoT-Cascade fusion).

nodes.name: Predator's Patience
nodes.description: Poison ticks deal +1/2/3/4/5% damage per second the target has been poisoned (max +25% at 25s).

nodes.name: Curare
nodes.description: Poisoned enemies take +5/10/15% increased damage from all sources.

nodes.name: Wound Mastery
nodes.description: Assassinate's Deep Wound consume payoff deals an additional +10/20/30/40/50% damage.

nodes.name: Snakes Among Us
nodes.description: On critical hit, +5/10/15/20/25% chance to apply Deep Wound regardless of skill.

nodes.name: Poison Mastery
nodes.description: Poison stack damage modifiers from this path stack +1/2/3 times instead of capping at base (lets you double/triple/quadruple-stack Toxic Edge + Acrid Concentration + Slow Decay).

nodes.name: Coiled Strike
nodes.description: Crits against poisoned enemies have +20/40/60% chance to fire an additional copy of the consumed skill.

nodes.name: Death Pact
nodes.description: Killing a poisoned enemy refunds 1/2/3 mana per active poison stack consumed.

nodes.name: Master Apothecary
nodes.description: Active poison stacks no longer decay while you have a Crit Stack at max (5/5). (Tier-6 preview of the Toxic Saint capstone effect; capstone amplifies further.)

nodes.name: Toxic Saint
nodes.description: Poison can crit. Your poison stacks no longer decay while Shadow Mark is active on any target. (Mirrors §10.1 Venomcraft ascendancy keystone — reshapes Crit Cascade by routing every poison tick through the crit engine, with Shadow Mark protecting the snapshot.)

nodes.name: Venom Sovereign
nodes.description: Poison crits add a Crit Stack and have +50% chance to extend Shadow Mark duration by 1s on the target.

paths.name: Shadowdancer
paths.theme: Mark momentum specialist. Mark applies cheap and often, follow-ups punish marks, Shadow Momentum compresses cooldowns. The Predator; first hit always finishes the encounter.

nodes.name: Stalker's Sense
nodes.description: Hits on Shadow Marked targets have +1/2/3/4/5% chance to crit.

nodes.name: Phantom Step
nodes.description: All cooldowns recover +1/2/3/4/5% faster (foundation pacing).

nodes.name: Killer's Grace
nodes.description: +1/2/3/4/5s Shadow Mark duration.

nodes.name: Mark Spread
nodes.description: Crits have +5/10/15/20/25% chance to apply Shadow Mark to an additional enemy in encounter.

nodes.name: Shadow Affinity
nodes.description: Shadow-tagged skills (Shadow Mark, Shadow Dash, Shadow Caltrops, Shadow Veil) cost 5/10/15/20/25% less mana.

nodes.name: Quick Reflexes
nodes.description: On taking a hit, +2/4/6/8/10% chance to gain Shadow Momentum.

nodes.name: Shadow Caltrops Reach
nodes.description: Shadow Caltrops applies Shadow Mark to all enemies in trap zone on detonation.

nodes.name: Cooldown Choreography
nodes.description: Shadow Momentum reduces 2s instead of 1s on the next skill's cooldown start.

nodes.name: From the Shadows
nodes.description: First hit on a new target deals +5/10/15/20/25% damage (patient-predator opener).

nodes.name: Hunter's Patience
nodes.description: Hits against Shadow Marked targets have +2/4/6/8/10% chance to refresh Shadow Mark to full duration.

nodes.name: Twin Marks
nodes.description: Shadow Mark skill applies to +1/2/3 additional enemies on cast (chained from primary target).

nodes.name: Cascade Conduit
nodes.description: Re-marks via crit on a Shadow Marked target have +5/10/15/20/25% chance to grant +2 Crit Stacks instead of +1.

nodes.name: Veil Mastery
nodes.description: Shadow Veil's offensive emerge component deals +5/10/15/20/25% damage.

nodes.name: Cross-Weapon Cascade
nodes.description: Crit Cascade triggers regardless of weapon equipped. Crits on any skill, any weapon, apply Shadow Mark and feed Crit Stacks. (Per §8.2 cross-weapon combo-state propagation — primary cross-weapon node for Asn.)

nodes.name: Echo Strike
nodes.description: On reaching 5 Crit Stacks, your next skill against a Shadow Marked target hits twice.

nodes.name: Shadow Covenant
nodes.description: While Shadow Mark is active on any target, +15% defense and +10% crit mult. (Migrated from Shadow Covenant active buff per SKILL_FANTASY_AUDIT — cut button, conditioned on Shadow Mark active to route Shadowdancer through its signature combo state.)

nodes.name: Mark Hunter
nodes.description: Skills consume Shadow Mark for +25/50/75% bonus damage on the consumer (instead of merely benefiting from the mark; payoff progression).

nodes.name: Shadow Resurgence
nodes.description: On killing a Shadow Marked enemy, +15/30/45% chance to instantly reduce all skill cooldowns by 1s.

nodes.name: Predator's Eye
nodes.description: Critical hits against Shadow Marked targets have +5/10/15% chance to also crit on the next non-Marked target hit (Cascade carry).

nodes.name: Phantom Speed
nodes.description: Shadow Momentum stacks (max 3 stacks); each stack independently applies its cooldown reduction to the next skill.

nodes.name: Stalker's Sigil
nodes.description: On crit, +1/2/3/4/5% chance to apply Shadow Mark to ALL enemies in encounter (burst Marker).

nodes.name: Untouchable Tempo
nodes.description: Hits on Shadow Marked targets have +5/10/15% chance to grant Shadow Momentum (preview of Untouchable capstone).

nodes.name: Veiled Strike
nodes.description: While Shadow Veil's invulnerability window is active, all your hits crit.

nodes.name: Cascade Echo
nodes.description: When Crit Stacks expire (target dies or stacks decay), +25/50/75% chance to gain Shadow Momentum (signature-momentum bridge).

nodes.name: Mass Reckoning
nodes.description: Skills that consume Shadow Mark consume marks on ALL Shadow Marked enemies in encounter, dealing the consume payoff to each.

nodes.name: Untouchable
nodes.description: Shadow Mark applies on first hit regardless of skill (no crit required). Hits on Shadow Marked targets generate Shadow Momentum (cooldowns start 2s earlier). (Mirrors §10.1 Shadowdancer ascendancy keystone — reshapes Crit Cascade by making mark application universal.)

nodes.name: Shadow Sovereign
nodes.description: While 3+ enemies in the encounter are Shadow Marked, +25% crit chance and Crit Stacks decay 50% slower.

categoryDistribution._note: Multi-rank flavor distribution: 67 of 81 nodes (~83%) carry proc/conditional/identity/buff_migration/cross_weapon flavor; 14 (~17%) are pure stat-sticks. Stat-sticks are tier-1/tier-2/tier-3 foundation pacing (crit chance, attack speed, crit damage, mana cost, duration scaling, max stacks) where simple values are appropriate per user 'SOME boring stat stick is fine' directive. All 3 tier-7 capstones reshape Crit Cascade signature.

engineHookDistribution.note: Phase C engineering: each unique engineHook needs an event-emit point in the engine. Asn-specific hooks: onCritStackChange, onCritStackMax, onCritStackExpire, onCascadeReMark, onShadowMarkConsume, onPoisonDotCrit. Procs ride on existing onSkillCrit/onSkillHit/onPoisonDotTick events; conditionals ride on stat resolution; identity nodes ride on signature mechanic dispatch.
engineHookDistribution.uniqueHooks: ~32 unique engineHook patterns across 81 nodes; many share base events (onSkillCrit, onSkillHit:targetShadowMarked, onPoisonDotTick, onEnemyKill:targetPoisoned, etc.)
